headline: North America's Largest Wildlife Overpass Cuts Highway Collisions by 91%
meta_description: A major wildlife overpass near Castle Rock has dramatically reduced animal-vehicle collisions on I-25, proving the infrastructure works.
summary_short: North America's largest wildlife overpass is preventing thousands of collisions. Near Castle Rock, I-25 animal-vehicle crashes plummeted 91%.
body:
North America's largest wildlife overpass has delivered on its promise: animal-vehicle collisions on I-25 near Castle Rock have dropped 91%.

The overpass was built to allow wildlife to cross the busy highway safely, reducing the deadly encounters that once claimed countless animals. The dramatic 91% reduction in collisions demonstrates that thoughtfully designed infrastructure can coexist with animal migration patterns and habitat connectivity.

This success story shows that investing in wildlife passages isn't just good for nature—it's practical. Fewer collisions mean safer roads for drivers too. As more communities face the challenge of balancing transportation and wildlife protection, the Castle Rock overpass stands as proof that the solution works.
quick_facts: 91% reduction in I-25 collisions near Castle Rock
Allows animals to cross highway safely
